title: Janus v2.2.0 — Full In-Call Management from Mac & Phone Screenshots
notes: Full In-Call Management from Mac: Answer remotely with auto-speakerphone activation (works seamlessly without Bluetooth)
Hardware In-Call Controls: Toggle phone speakerphone, mute/unmute mic, and send DTMF keypad digits from Mac
Live In-Call HUD: Active call banner with caller name, number, duration, and control buttons
Dedicated Screenshots Tab: Browse, preview, and download phone screenshots from Media & Files tab
Capture Phone Screenshot: 1-click button on Mac to capture live screenshot on phone
Fix: Added 5s safety timeout to prevent stuck Loading state in Media browser
